description: This file defines functions for verifying and performing firmware upgrades tailored for specific hardware boards. It includes a board detection function and conditional logic to invoke appropriate upgrade routines based on the detected board identifier.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that performs a basic check of the upgrade image, currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function that determines the board type and executes the appropriate upgrade routine based on the board name.
